name: huggingface-skills
description: USER LEVEL: You train, evaluate, and publish models and datasets from the editor—no notebooks or SSH sessions required for common Hub operations. PROJECT LEVEL: ML pipelines stay reproducible because dataset configs, training runs, and eval scores are managed through structured skills instead of ad-hoc scripts. End-to-end Hugging Face Hub workflows—datasets, cloud Jobs training, evaluations, Trackio experiments, paper pages, and Gradio demos—via skills and MCP tools. BEST SUITED FOR: • ML teams using Hugging Face for model training and dataset management • Research groups publishing papers and evaluation benchmarks • Projects building Gradio demos or Spaces-backed prototypes
